221     def total_energy_now(self, meter):

226         influx_measure = meter.get('influx_measure_base_name')

232         # calculate consumed energy only if previous reading cache for the trigger period is found
233         if not self.prev_readings: #empty dict evaluates to false
234             logger.info(f"No previous readings exist for trigger interval '{self.interval}'. Consumed energy will be calculated on next trigger.")
235             return False
236

238             meter_id = m.get('meter_id')
239             meter_prev_reading = next(i for i in self.prev_readings[self.interval]['readings'] if i['meter_id'] == meter_id)
240             meter_current_reading = next(j for j in self.readings_cache[self.interval]['readings'] if j['meter_id'] == meter_id)
241             #  {"meter_id": 10, "measurement_total": "line0-total", "value_total": 0.95}
242 
243             consumed = round(meter_current_reading['value_total'] - meter_prev_reading['value_total'],2)
244             logger.info(f"Consumed energy on meter '{meter_id}' for the last '{self.interval}' period is '{consumed}' kWh")
245 
246             measure_base_name = m.get('influx_measure_base_name')
247             self.publish_to_influx_lst.append({"measurement":measure_base_name+"Last" + self.interval, 
248                                                "time":self.readings_cache[self.interval]["readtime_str"],
249                                                "fields":dict(item=measure_base_name+"Last" + self.interval,
250                                                              value=consumed)})
251

253         #     json.dump(self.publish_to_influx_lst, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=4)
254         return True

256     def write_to_influx(self):
257         logger.info("Publishing total and interval results into influx db...")
258         client = InfluxDBClient(**INLUX_DB)
259         client.write_points(self.publish_to_influx_lst)
260         logger.info("Done!")
